On Tuesday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. Lily has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. Little by little, things began to change. In fact, an annulment erases the marriage legally.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Toronto. Also, the landscape changes from hills to flat fields.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Lily ordered fish and tea at the temple fair last night. What's more, the ski resort opens in December.

Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans. At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. For example, it's my pleasure to help you.
People around Lily often share different ideas about the moon-lit yard. Lily thanked Eva for the honest advice. Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
